g.text: UML - immutable incoming and return reconciliation, suspense and ownership
original membership, source clock and digest
signed request binding + independent immutable file
discover movement + suspense / allocation / original receipts
repeatable-read facts + lifetime returned principal + clock
confirm explicit workflow and file movement identities
committed native facts, original finality and cap
[every bank / provider / journal identity in union]
verify movement signature / scope / amount / value date
return original settlement / payer / cumulative principal cap
exact suspense and allocation journal legs / original links
independent file claims + captured GL / actual booking dates
commit summary / private proofs / stable rows / issues + audit
original case ID after lost ACK
MATCHED requires native customer allocation plus exact captured evidence.
Funds in suspense remain PARTIAL and owned.
A provider over-cap return claim cannot become bank money.
Separate source clocks; no global atomic snapshot claim.
verify hashes, archived HMAC, parent and membership
safe retained lineage + current case links
